description: Ledger 14 predeclared normalized detector-observation-noise survival gate and artifact identity.

siege_cell_decisions.rationale: Ledger 14 found that both declared delayed linear targets survived the predeclared 1e-8 normalized observation-noise gate with positive paired lower envelopes.
siege_cell_decisions.decision_scope: Advance only the replicated normalized Kerr quadrature linear-memory lead to bounded siege; no nonlinear, detector-physical, material, or device claim.

parameter_regions.name: Ledger 14 predeclared detector-noise decision point
parameter_regions.decision_scope: Registry projection of the principal siege axes at the 1e-8 decision floor; the hash-addressed frozen TOML is authoritative for the complete protocol.

conjecture_dispositions.rationale: The predeclared normalized detector-observation-noise gate survived while no nonlinear target replicated.
conjecture_dispositions.decision_scope: Local normalized-model survival only; not nonlinear computation, a connected region, detector calibration, material validation, or Conjecture 5.

protocols.name: Ledger 14 normalized detector-observation-noise gate
protocols.decision_scope: Matched Kerr/Kerr-disabled quadrature sweep over noise std 0, 1e-10, 1e-9, 1e-8, and descriptive 1e-7; the predeclared decision floor is 1e-8.

runs.summary: At normalized observation-noise std 1e-8, Kerr lag-three and lag-four targets were FWER-significant in 3/3 seeds and their paired lower-envelope advantages were +0.003779 and +0.014251. Noise-aware dimension was 12 versus noiseless rank 14; raw-equivalent gate-target weight norms were about 1.24e6 to 4.94e6. No nonlinear target replicated.

evidence_artifacts.description: Ignored per-run canonical detail database. Registry stores only its identity, expected hash, availability, and summary links; it does not duplicate target rows.

gate_results.metric_text: Kerr significant 3/3; disabled significant 3/3; paired delta positive 3/3
gate_results.decision_scope: Predeclared 1e-8 normalized observation-noise floor at the frozen point.
gate_results.limitation: The earned claim is positive Kerr advantage, not unique existence of lag-three memory; the control is also significant 3/3.

gate_results.metric_text: Kerr significant 3/3; disabled significant 1/3; paired delta positive 3/3
gate_results.decision_scope: Predeclared 1e-8 normalized observation-noise floor at the frozen point.
gate_results.limitation: The earned claim is a local positive Kerr advantage, not nonlinear computation or physical detector robustness.

gate_results.decision_scope: Degree-two or degree-three targets at the predeclared decision floor.
gate_results.limitation: This closes the local nonlinear gate, not every possible parameter region.

gate_results.metric_text: noise-aware dimension 12; noiseless rank 14; disabled dimension 4
gate_results.decision_scope: Declared one-standard-deviation principal-axis observability convention at noise std 1e-8.
gate_results.limitation: A declared normalized robustness diagnostic, not an instrument-derived universal definition of observability.

comparisons.control_relationship: Matched Kerr-disabled quadrature condition using common detector-noise draws within every seed/noise pair
comparisons.metric: corrected total capacity, Kerr minus disabled, at detector-noise std 1e-8
comparisons.decision_scope: Three paired seeds at the predeclared normalized decision floor; 1e-7 remains descriptive only.
